label: For every frame F and standpoint w, the schema □ →, valid over ALL world predicates G, holds iff…
paraphrase: For every frame F and standpoint w, the schema □(G → □G) → (◇G → □G), valid over ALL world predicates G, holds iff every ordered successor pair is connected by Mathlib reflexive-transitive masked reachability. Euclidean frames suffice by one step; reflexive symmetric frames suffice by two steps through w. A fixed three-world reflexive symmetric line has this connectivity at every standpoint but is not Euclidean, proving Euclideanness is not necessary. This is an exact pointwise all-predicate correspondence, not a characterization for one fixed G, restricted admissible predicates, or metaphysical modality.
